root_idea.summary: The root centers on rising, emerging, and becoming visible.
root_idea.development: The primary image is the rising or appearance of a star; this extends to things that sprout or emerge, such as plants, teeth, horns, and thoughts. The sense of scheduled installments is associated with payments recurring at successive star-risings.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular noun citation form.

senses.usage_conditions: Used for visible celestial bodies, including stars used for guidance and orientation. In فِي النُّجُومِ, the expression may refer to observing or having knowledge of the stars. In 53:1, an interpretation identifies the star specifically with the Pleiades; the astronomical reading of 56:75 concerns the positions of the stars.
In 55:6, the word is understood as vegetation without a stalk or trunk, in contrast with الشجر.

senses.definition: In an interpretive Quranic reading, the Qur’an revealed or sent down in successive portions.
senses.usage_conditions: This alternative reading applies to النجم in 53:1 and to مواقع النجوم in 56:75; هَوَى is then understood as the Qur’an’s descent rather than the falling of a star.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise, emerge, appear, or become manifest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a star, tooth, horn, plant, or an idea that comes forth or becomes apparent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rising, emergence, or appearance as a verbal-noun use.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The form نُجُومٌ can denote the act of rising or appearing as well as functioning as the plural of نَجْمٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To rise up in disobedience or rebellion against a ruler.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with عَلَى referring to becoming insubordinate to authority.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Root-sprouting shoots or certain stemless grasses and plants, especially couch grass.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Classical botanical use, including shoots emerging from a plant’s roots and the plant identified as Triticum repens or dogs’ grass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An appointed payment term; hence, an installment or scheduled payment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The installment sense is associated with payments recurring at successive star-risings and may also refer to payments scheduled by another reckoning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To distribute or assess a payment in installments.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb describes assigning successive portions for payment, later extending to arranging payment according to any specified schedule.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Astrology or judgment based on the stars.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun for interpreting or making judgments by stellar observations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cease or let up, especially of rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of rain and similar phenomena coming to an end.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The transverse iron beam of a balance that holds the tongue.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical term for the crosspiece in a weighing balance.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Star meaning represented under the Quranic noun.
Asterism and Pleiades reference subsumed under the astral sense.
Due-time meaning represented with the installment branch.

cautions: The Quranic form has two materially distinct attested readings in 55:6: a celestial star reading and a stemless-plant reading.
In 53:1 and 56:75, the celestial interpretation competes with an interpretation referring to the Qur’an’s gradual revelation; the supplied contextual glosses reflect the celestial reading only.
